summary.intent: Update the codebase map after phases 28-33 completion, then perform broader planning hygiene: clean up stale docs, resolve deferred items, audit the security backlog, and add a new E2E testing phase to the roadmap.
summary.outcome: Updated CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md to reflect phases 28-33, sanitized a private IP address from 15 planning files, audited and updated the security backlog (7 items marked resolved), moved a completed deferred item, added Phase 34 (E2E test expansion) to the roadmap, and opened two PRs (#390, #391) capturing all changes.

repo: Phase 28 resolved console.log pervasiveness (127 calls replaced), but 12 residual console.time/timeEnd calls survive in apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts
registerFaroTransport() is defined in the Faro integration but never called, meaning logger.error/warn calls do not reach Grafana Faro

Phase 31 decomposed useSharedNavigation.ts (1199→378 lines) and FileBrowser.tsx (964→362 lines); folder.service.ts (1059) and bin.service.ts (971) remain large but are now considered cohesive enough to not warrant a standalone concern
Phase 32 resolved async FilePointer on macOS; Phase 33 resolved it on Windows — both crates/fuse/src/read_ops.rs and crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/read_ops.rs now use rt.spawn() channel patterns
19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites exist in FUSE production code — a new concern as poisoned mutexes can cause cascading panics
IPNS unenrollment is fire-and-forget with no persistence across tab closure — known limitation, not a regression
The legacy POC directory was removed in commit ee9bcd4e4 (Phase 28) but the CONCERNS.md entry was never updated
The private IP 192.168.133.114 (docker host) was referenced in 15 planning files; all replaced with <docker-host>

All 7 Phase 9 security backlog items (#13-19: ThrottlerGuard, URL encoding, eprintln!, key log, key zeroize, error sanitization) were resolved organically across later phases but never marked as such in LOW-SEVERITY-BACKLOG.md

The Entire CLI injects its own git hooks (.husky/post-commit, pre-push, prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg.pre-entire) alongside project husky hooks — these are local machine artifacts and should be excluded via .git/info/exclude

code.finding: Backlog had 19 items; 7 (all Phase 9 items #13-19) were resolved but not marked — updated to reflect current state leaving 12 open Phase 5 items
Stale entry referencing legacy POC directory that was deleted in Phase 28 (commit ee9bcd4e4)
Stale reference to docker host IP 192.168.133.114 — removed as unnecessary and now sanitized
Status column contained unnecessary phase annotations (Phase 28, Phase 30) and 'generated' labels — removed for cleaner docs

workflow: When pulling after a diverged branch, stashing specific files, resetting to origin/main, and restoring is cleaner than merging planning-only docs
Mapper agents should be re-run against latest main after a pull when the concern being mapped was specifically addressed by the merged phase
Planning docs accumulate stale state quickly — a post-phase hygiene pass (deferred items, security backlogs, concerns) is worth doing after every few phases
gsd-codebase-mapper agents write documents directly and return only confirmations — orchestrator context stays minimal
CodeRabbit review comments on planning doc PRs tend to be minor (stale dates, formatting) and are worth a quick resolve pass before merging

friction: git pull failed due to divergent branches after the initial STRUCTURE.md commit — required stash, hard reset to origin/main, and restore
PR description update via gh pr edit failed on first attempt (exit code 1) and required a retry
The initial concerns mapping pass was done against a pre-Phase-33 tree, requiring the agent to be re-run after pulling latest main
open_items: Phase 34 planned but not yet executed: AES-CTR streaming playback E2E tests, media preview E2E suite, batch download zip E2E tests, shared deleteAccount teardown, BYO-IPFS load test baselines, staging metrics capture (todos #7-12)
Mutex unwrap() calls in FUSE production code — 19+ lock().unwrap() sites that can panic on poisoned mutex (new concern in CONCERNS.md)
registerFaroTransport() never called — logger.error/warn calls do not reach Grafana Faro (new concern in CONCERNS.md)
12 residual console.time/timeEnd calls in apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts not covered by Phase 28 logger migration
12 open Phase 5 security backlog items (input validation, defense-in-depth) — all low severity, none addressed in phases 28-33
PR #390 (codebase map update) and PR #391 (docs cleanup + Phase 34 roadmap) both open and need review/merge
